model.coordinates: x = 0 entrance surface; interface at x = T; *_from_interface = x - T
model.electronic_loss: NonLocal (default): no local loss; the crystal local/nonlocal ratio deviation of #250 is not addressed
model.engine: Bca, constant free path, crystal flight model in the substrate
model.oxide: amorphous SiO2, 2200 kg/m3, E_d = 15 eV (Si, O), amorphous transport
model.substrate_controls: amorphous Si at the crystal density, same stack and seed
model.tail_thresholds: 2 and 3 times the bare amorphous control Rp (same ion and direction), below the interface
model.uncertainty: one standard error: sigma/sqrt(n) for means, sqrt(f(1-f)/n) for fractions; per-history, seeds fixed and shared across configurations

thermal.sampling: per-encounter, uncorrelated: each lattice site met along a straight flight line gets one isotropic Gaussian displacement (standard deviation u1 per Cartesian axis, Debye model) drawn from the history's thermal stream; redrawn after every collision
